issues.title: Custom domain not reachable
issues.problem_statement: The customer's custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days, while the funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on the customer's own domain.

issues.title: Secure certificate padlock after connecting
issues.problem_statement: The padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after the domain is connected, and support will check it has been issued.

items.description: Customer opened the domain in an incognito window as a first check and still saw the same error.
evidence: Opened in incognito. Still the same error.

items.description: Support explained that an old A record for the domain pointing to an old server address was blocking the connection, and that it needed to be replaced with a CNAME record using the target value shown in the FlexiFunnels domain settings.
evidence: That old record is blocking the connection.
add a CNAME record for shop, using the target value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record and added the CNAME record at their domain registrar and saved it, following support's guidance; the dashboard then showed the domain as connected and the customer confirmed the domain loads.
evidence: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.

items.description: Support explained that the www version still showed an error because a second record for www pointed somewhere else, and that it needed to be replaced with a CNAME for www with the same target value.
evidence: you have a second record for www pointing somewhere else

items.description: Customer deleted the second www record and added a CNAME for www with the same target value, following support's guidance, and confirmed both the domain and its www version now load the funnel.
evidence: Both shop.testfunnel.example and the www version are loading our funnel now.
